verdict.rationale: Tilled explicitly supports white-labeling (custom domain for API/console/dev portal, 'white-label functionality', 'Customize and build your own UI', OnboardingJS, DisputesAPI for custom dispute UI) which lets a developer embed seller-facing merchant/dispute/onboarding surfaces under their own brand. However, evidence does not show dedicated APIs/components specifically for balances or transaction history embedding — those appear only as Dashboard/Console views, not documented embeddable primitives. missing for 10: explicit balances API/component, explicit transaction-history API/component for embedding, independent confirmation of white-label UI in production.
